items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I always wondered if he was any relation. I never got a chance to meet him to ask him.

ctx.x:
Well, that's what I don't quite understand. See, all I know is that from the time it seems that I can remember, when he was talking about musicians, he would always say Big Head Clarence, you know, he said he was one of my prize pupils and he said that he left and went to New York and became very successful. But he was the guy that he used to talk about, you know, most when I was very small.

Now that's, you know, Cootie and Ben came much later, but this was the man who, when I was very, very small I would hear…
was a good show out here, and his name was Clarence Williams the Third. I always wondered if he was any relation. I never got a chance to meet him to ask him.
You mentioned a great long string of instruments that your father played, but you never mentioned drums. Was that just an omission, or ...
